turns.assessment: The simultaneous two errored seconds across many optical channels and the brief protection switches at t=600–601.1 strongly indicate a fast polarization transient on the common S04–S15 fibre route. Stable power, OSNR, amplifier telemetry, and sampled SOP-rate argue against a cut, loss increase, amplifier fault, or persistent ROADM fault; a millisecond-scale SOP transient can evade those instruments. The evidence does not identify which span or direction was disturbed, so no individual repair target reaches 80%.
